name: MonarchSiteShell
title: SiteHeader and SiteFooter
summary: The frame of a public, signed-out area of an app: a top app bar with the brand, a menu button and actions, a navigation drawer with the site's links, a scrolling body and MonarchSiteFooter.
whenToUse: For a welcome or product tour area that has a few destinations of its own and a footer with legal links.
whenNotToUse: Inside the signed-in app, use the app's own Scaffold with NavigationSuiteScaffold. For the Rook company bar, use MonarchRookBar.
api: @Composable fun MonarchSiteShell(brand: String, nav: List<MonarchSiteNavItem>, onNavigate: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, drawerState: DrawerState = rememberDrawerState(DrawerValue.Closed), actions: (@Composable RowScope.() -> Unit)? = null, footer: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, openNavigationLabel: String? = null, navigationLabel: String? = null, content: @Composable ColumnScope.() -> Unit)

@Composable fun MonarchSiteFooter(columns: List<MonarchSiteFooterColumn>, onNavigate: (String) -> Unit, modifier: Modifier = Modifier, legal: String? = null, legalLinks: List<MonarchSiteNavLink> = emptyList())
class MonarchSiteNavItem(label: String, link: String? = null, items: List<MonarchSiteNavLink> = emptyList())
class MonarchSiteNavLink(label: String, link: String, description: String? = null)

options.name: brand
options.description: The name in the top app bar and at the top of the drawer.

options.name: nav
options.description: The drawer entries: a link, or a group of links that expands.

options.name: onNavigate
options.description: Called with the link the user taps; the drawer closes.

options.name: drawerState
options.description: The state of the navigation drawer.

options.name: actions
options.description: Actions at the end of the top app bar, such as "Log in" and "Get started".

options.name: footer
options.description: The footer after the content, normally MonarchSiteFooter.

options.name: openNavigationLabel
options.description: The spoken name of the menu button. null uses "Open navigation".

options.name: navigationLabel
options.description: The spoken name of the drawer. null uses "Site navigation".

options.name: content
options.description: The body, in a scrolling column before the footer.

states.name: drawer closed
states.description: The top app bar, the body and the footer.

states.name: drawer open
states.description: The modal drawer with the brand and the entries over a scrim; a group expands in place.

appearance: The top app bar and the drawer use the surface with a subtle line under the bar; the body sits on the canvas. Footer titles use the default text, links the muted colour, the legal line the muted caption. The same roles apply in light, dark and both high-contrast themes.
platformNotes: The web SiteHeader shows the links in a horizontal bar with dropdowns and a sticky option, and SiteFooter shows link columns side by side. On Android the links are in a Material 3 modal navigation drawer behind the menu button at every width, the bar is a top app bar row (menu button, brand that ends with an ellipsis when short of room, actions), and the footer stacks its groups. Links are app-defined strings passed to onNavigate.
accessibility: The menu button is named "Open navigation"; the drawer is a pane named "Site navigation".
Drawer entries are MonarchMegaMenu rows: buttons with 48dp touch targets, groups read their expanded state.
Footer group titles are headings; every footer link is a button with a touch target of at least 48dp.
The footer is a traversal group read after the content.
edgeCases: A long brand is cut by the top app bar when the actions take the room; keep actions short.
The drawer closes before onNavigate is called.
